subject: Marketplace listing readiness: catalog SKU mapping & network boundary clarifications
messages:
From: Julia Liu <julia.liu@enterpriseco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace procurement: upfront data for catalog listing

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team here is excited about Redwood’s cost controls and deployment modes. Procurement and our cloud team asked me to collect a few items to accelerate an AWS/GCP catalog listing review: 

- A SKU-level mapping for how usage will appear in marketplace metering (per-region metering, per-instance or per-token granularity)
- Network boundary diagram (VPC endpoints, egress requirements, recommended NAT/gateway rules)
- Confirmation of whether private deployments (Bring Your Own VPC) require additional partner attestation for marketplace listing

Can you provide a single checklist or workbook we can circulate to procurement and our marketplace onboarding team? We have an internal deadline to submit the listing packet by Oct 2.

I can share our procurement intake if that helps.

Thanks,
Julia Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
Enterpriseco

Attachments: none
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Liu <julia.liu@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement: upfront data for catalog listing

Hi Julia — great to hear and thanks for the clear ask. I’m looping Karthik (marketplace integrations) and Laura (product ops) so we can assemble a single package for your review. 

Action plan: 
1) I’m attaching a working workbook (catalog-sku-mapping.xlsx) with our recommended SKU taxonomy. It includes columns for: marketplace SKU, internal product SKU, metric (tokens/instances), regional metering flag, and estimated mapping notes.
2) Karthik will add a short VPC/network guidance note and a diagram for BYOVPC/private deployments.
3) Laura will prepare a short cover memo that outlines any attestation language required for marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure differences).

Can you confirm the preferred metering model: per-token (hosted) vs. per-instance-hour (dedicated) vs. blended? If you have a preference per product line, add a quick note to the workbook and we’ll adapt.

We’ll get a draft back to you by EOD Thursday (23rd).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: catalog-sku-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Julia Liu <julia.liu@enterpriseco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace procurement: upfront data for catalog listing

Thanks, Sean — this is perfect. A few clarifications from procurement/cloud: 

- Metering: for our catalog we prefer per-region metering reported as usage units per hour for SKU-based billing; however for AI workloads we may accept per-token for hosted offerings. Please include both variants in the workbook per product line.
- Networking: we need explicit egress IP ranges for any hosted outbound traffic to our telemetry/billing endpoints (GCP Pub/Sub and S3 endpoints). If Redwood uses dynamic pools, provide an alternative mechanism (e.g., NAT gateway ranges + CIDR list update cadence).
- Attestation: we will need a statement confirming whether Redwood’s private deployment package requires additional marketplace-only attestation or if the same security artifacts (SOC2, audit logs) suffice.

I attached a doc with our standard marketplace intake (enterpriseco-security-answers.docx) and a short diagram of our catalog onboarding expectations.

Would appreciate the revised workbook and the network boundary PDF back by EOD Friday (24th) so we can bundle for the marketplace team.

Julia Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
Enterpriseco

Attachments: enterpriseco-security-answers.docx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Deliverables for Enterpriseco marketplace packet (due EOD today)

Karthik / Laura — quick internal summary and asks (I’ll send the final package to Julia after your updates):

Deliverables: 
- Updated catalog-sku-mapping.xlsx: include both per-token and per-hour columns; add a per-region metering flag and short notes for each SKU (who owns pricing decision). (Karthik: please review the metric columns.)
- Network boundary PDF (network-boundaries.pdf): include explicit egress ranges (or a statement describing dynamic NAT ranges + update cadence), BYOVPC configuration checklist, and any recommended firewall rules for telemetry endpoints. (Karthik: draft diagram; Laura: review for marketplace language.)
- Attestation memo: 1-page cover explaining data artifacts we provide for marketplace listing (SOC2 cert, audit logs, KMS/HSM note, and whether private package needs listing-specific attestation). (Laura: draft.)

Risks / notes: 
- If Enterpriseco insists on per-region fixed IP ranges and we don’t have a static pool for hosted, procurement may ask for a partner NAT solution or marketplace exception. We should explain fallback options and likely timeline to enable static ranges per region.
- Pricing owner: clarify which PM owns pricing for SKU X and whether we can support both unit types for GA.

Timeline: Final package -> me by 3:30pm PT today, I’ll consolidate and send to Julia by 4:30pm.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier messages preserved where applicable.
